# Mallige font

`app/src/main/res/font/mallige_bold.ttf` is **Mallige Bold, version 1.06**, a Kannada OpenType font
© 2005 Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore (Indian Language Technology Solutions Project),
distributed under the GNU General Public License version 2 (see `COPYING`).

Source: the Brahmi project, https://brahmi.sourceforge.net
("OpenType font for Kannada - Kedage and Mallige Ver 1.0", `kanotf.zip`, file `Malige-b.TTF`, unmodified).

Hejje uses it only to draw its name, ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ.
